title: 2025 cost recovery — Bayview Clinic
instructions: Bayview Clinic, a calendar-year professional corporation, placed the assets below in service in 2025. Compute each amount for Bayview's 2025 Form 4562. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Assets placed in service in 2025
exhibits.content:
| Asset | Class | Cost | Placed in service |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Medical equipment | 5-year | 300,000 | April 14 |
| Computers | 5-year | 50,000 | December 1 |
| Office furniture | 7-year | 70,000 | January 8 |
| Clinic building (nonresidential) | 39-year | 1,200,000, including land of 300,000 | February 20 |
| Goodwill bought with a practice acquisition | §197 | 360,000 | July 1 |

exhibits.title: Elections and rates
exhibits.content:
- Elect **§179 of $100,000** on the medical equipment; Bayview has ample business income and total qualifying purchases are well under the phase-out threshold.
- **Elect out of bonus** depreciation for all classes.
- Half-year first-year rates: 5-year 20.00%; 7-year 14.29%. Real property: straight-line, mid-month convention.

rows.label: Percentage of 2025 depreciable personal property placed in service in the fourth quarter
rows.explanation: 50,000 ÷ 420,000 = **11.9%**, not more than 40%, so the half-year convention applies (real property and §197 intangibles are excluded).

rows.label: MACRS depreciation on the medical equipment
MACRS depreciation on the office furniture
Depreciation on the clinic building
rows.explanation: (1,200,000 − 300,000) ÷ 39 = 23,077 a year; February under mid-month is 10.5 months: **20,192**.
